svg.title: deveggs repo setup
svg.text: deveggs setup: one clone, a personal basket, shared baskets, and every harness wired to it
branch main · changes land by PR
installed by git clone, not npm
any other file fails the PR
scaffolding, so a pull can never
Tool PRs branch from upstream main,
never from a branch that carries
how to browse, import and share

g.text: git pull: tool updates; never touches my-basket/
borrow: deveggs import <user>/<id>; always an egg, trials reset to ✓0 ✗0
share: deveggs share redacts a copy and opens a PR to deveggs-baskets
sync (optional): fork, un-ignore my-basket/, commit it in the fork
install: the agent symlinks skills and adds a managed block in every harness

svg.text: README prompt, pasted once · needs Node ≥ 22.18 and git

g.text: find every harness; plan links + prompt blocks
offer to seed my-basket from existing notes,
one confirmed egg at a time (never automatic)
• A chicken skill wins over a same-named egg skill.
• The agent unlinks a skill when it is cracked.
• Nothing is copied: the basket stays the source of truth.
• Every harness found: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, …
• To uninstall, any agent removes the links and the block.

svg.text: (e) Agent and basket at runtime: every change goes through the CLI

g.text: chickens first, then eggs on trial.
Follow eggs as trials and watch
on a real signal, with a note

svg.text: bin/deveggs writes my-basket/; every change re-renders PREFERENCES.md; run install after a skill hatches or cracks
Agents draft, ask and record. Only the developer confirms lays and decides hatches and cracks.

g.text: Figure 2. How the deveggs repo is set up. (a) Upstream holds the tool; shared baskets live in deveggs-baskets; CI keeps my-basket/ empty. (b) In the local clone, the tool
arrives by git pull while my-basket/ stays personal and gitignored; numbered arrows are the flows listed in (b). (c) Install is a git clone plus a confirmed
install step that an agent runs from INSTALL.md. (d) install symlinks skills and adds a managed block to each harness. (e) At runtime the agent reads the basket and changes it only through the CLI.
